caption: The video captures a large white Star Cruises cruise ship underway in open water, filmed from a rear-quarter aerial angle that reveals its stern and port hull. The red-and-blue funnel bears a yellow star, and a row of orange lifeboats lines the side above the painted "STAR CRUISES" lettering. The vessel maintains a steady heading with its bow angled to the right. A white foamy wake churns at the stern and spreads in a V-shape behind the hull. A camera holds a fixed aerial position, keeping the ship centered while the coastline and distant skyline remain largely static in the background. On the left, a green hill rises above a row of high-rise residential blocks, while a distant city skyline stretches along the right horizon. A blue sky scattered with cumulus clouds hangs overhead. The ship's heading and apparent size remain essentially unchanged throughout, and the stern wake continuously reforms, marking steady progress through the water rather than any turn or stop.
